headline: School Board Approves New Initiatives as TCSD Enrollment Falls by 158 Students
summary: The board approved personnel, field trips, fundraisers, facility-use requests, donations, three student transfers, school safety and crisis plans and several contracts and subscriptions, including professional services from Buse Educational Services for Belmont High School and TCHS. The superintendent reported enrollment of 2,637 on Aug. 7, 2026, down 158 from 2,795 on Aug. 5, 2025.

personnel.note: Hires include 7 substitutes (teachers, cafeteria, nurse, bus driver), a counselor (80% retiree), a custodian, a cafeteria worker, 2 route bus drivers and a special education assistant teacher; other = 3 employees approved to work with Special Olympics athletes outside the school day at their hourly rate and 2 volunteers.

money.item: TVA Stem Robotics Award for a Career & Technical Center class (accepted)
Surveying services at Iuka Middle School for drainage issues
money.vendor: Moore Hall & Wages Engineering & Surveying, LLC

money.item: Annual inspection of fire alarm system, Burnsville School
Professional development / data coaching for administrators and teacher groups, 2026/2027
Annual inspection of fire alarm system, Iuka Elementary
Annual monitoring of fire alarm system, Iuka Elementary
LJ Create Working with STEM 1-year subscriptions for STEM labs at Belmont, TCHS and TCCTC
Lumos Learning subscription for IMS ATSI remediation (School Improvement Funds)
Professional services days for high school academics and counseling at Belmont High School and TCHS, 2026/2027

donations.note: Includes $2,500 ($500/month) from Paradise UMC to TES for 2026/2027.

superintendent: Belmont and TCHS campuses have lost a total of 4 AC units since school started due to filters not being cleaned properly; the district is reviewing options, and one unit is under warranty.
One STOPit report was made at Tishomingo School.
Enrollment was 2,637 on Aug. 7, 2026, compared with 2,795 on Aug. 5, 2025, a loss of 158 students; IES had the largest loss (43) and Tishomingo School decreased by 6.
Spring testing results roll out in September, with school letter grades expected in October.
The district is beginning a PEER Helper program for students in grades 3-12, with implementation planned for the spring.
The Vector Solutions reporting system, replacing StopIt, is almost ready to be implemented.
No school Sept. 7 for Labor Day; next regular meeting Sept. 14, 2026.
otherActions: 13 field trip requests approved (several list multiple destinations or dates)
School Occupational Safety and Crisis Plans for IMS, TCHS, TES and Belmont
TCSD Job Description Handbook, Substitute Teacher Handbook and Professional Development Plan
Video streaming agreement with Jack Ivy Broadcasting for 2026/2027 (amount not printed)
